title: Anidulafungin in invasive fungal infection: NOT POOLABLE -- PARTICIPANTS + OUTCOME
topic_state: NOT POOLABLE -- decided from the registrations
verification_basis: Both registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18 including posted results.
risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades trials contributing to a pooled result; this page publishes none.

handbook_authority.handbook: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions
handbook_authority.c62: 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.poolable_reason: TWO TRIALS THAT DIFFER IN POPULATION AND REPORT THE OUTCOME IN DIFFERENT UNITS, ON DENOMINATORS TOO SMALL TO POOL. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18. NCT00805740 enrols candidiasis and fungemia and posts global response as a PERCENTAGE (83.3 percent of 24 against 61.5 percent of 13). NCT00806351 enrols fungemia WITH NEUTROPENIA and posts COUNTS (8 of 11 against 3 of 3). NEUTROPENIA IS NOT A CO-LABEL, IT CHANGES BOTH THE INFECTION AND THE OUTCOME: the host response that clears candidaemia is the response neutropenia removes, so 'global response' does not mean the same thing in the two trials. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor -- each is registered and reports its own primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that the question this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials this page carries. THE CRITICISM IS OF THE POOLING AND OF NOTHING ELSE. Registry read 2026-08-18.
primary.the_denominators_alone_would_close_it: THE COMPARATOR ARMS HOLD 13 AND 3 PARTICIPANTS. A three-participant arm cannot support an interval worth displaying whatever the population. Recorded SECOND because the population difference is the principled reason and the denominators are the practical one; either is sufficient and neither depends on the other.
primary.the_caveat_this_topic_carried_into_the_b: This topic was KEPT at the candidate stage with the neutropenic split flagged as a question to answer at build time rather than a reason to close in advance. The build answered it: it closes. The flag was right to be a flag and right not to be a verdict.
